**Reason for Mistake:** The Planner mistakenly identified Mara Wilson as the actress who played Susan Walker in the 1947 version of *Miracle on 34th Street*. This error occurred due to conflating the 1947 version with the 1994 remake, where Mara Wilson played Susan Walker, rather than confirming which version of the movie the task referred to. This initial wrong assumption led to incorrect instructions being passed to the WebSurfer and created a cascade of redundant searches and errors, delaying the resolution of the task.
